title: College and Math Skill Building Success

program.section_heading: College and Math Skill Building Success Certificate of Competency
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to successfully navigate both on-campus and online resources.

Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to choose and apply essential tools and strategies necessary to support independent learning to reach their goals of certification, graduation, and/or transfer.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to demonstrate knowledge of the real number system and its operations.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to solve equations, graph linear and quadratic functions, and use formulas.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to apply problem-solving skills to real-world problems that would be relevant to their transfer-level math class.

notes: Noncredit program counted in hours: the catalog states 'Core Courses-27 hours (Credits listed are in hours)'. Total and block stated recorded as 27 hours.
The catalog prints hours as ranges with a zero high end ('9 - 0', '18 - 0', 'Total 27 - 0'); read as single values of 9, 18 and 27 hours. Reviewer may check.
Course codes are printed without a space (ACDVB55NC, MATHB99NC); they match closed-list ACDV B55NC and MATH B99NC.

Catalog title reads 'College Success and Math Skill Building Certificate of Competency' in the description, while the heading reads 'College and Math Skill Building Success Certificate of Competency'.
Courses must be completed with a grade of 'P'.
